artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Driven from the Tavern
artworks.artist: Theodoor van Thulden after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group in historical attire. In the foreground, a muscular figure is being restrained by another figure. The scene appears intense, with dramatic poses and expressions. Off to the side, two figures appear to be watching the event unfold, one of them gesturing animatedly. The architecture consists of stone structures, arches, and pillars. A dog is positioned in the lower left corner. The artwork is rendered in a style reminiscent of early illustrative engravings, emphasizing contrast and detail with cross-hatching and dynamic lines.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son among the Swine
artworks.artist: Theodoor van Thulden after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated under a tree. The person is leaning against the tree trunk, holding a staff. They have wavy hair, a draped garment, and are surrounded by a landscape with hills, cows, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son Received by His Father
artworks.artist: Theodoor van Thulden after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a kneeling figure near a doorway with a landscape visible beyond. The drawing depicts an interior scene with a person kneeling at a doorway, clutching the hand of a standing figure dressed in flowing robes. Several other figures gather around in attentive postures, gesturing and observing the interaction. To the right, through the architectural feature of a doorway or window, a landscape is visible, showing rolling hills and a distant building. A dog is present in the foreground, paying no attention to the human activity. The strong use of line and cross-hatching gives depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: The Virgin with the Rose
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in green and gray
artworks.description: The image depicts two central figures within a circular frame. One figure is a woman seated in profile view, holding a child. The woman's upper body and arms are visible, as well as her delicately carved facial features and elaborate updo. She is clothed in a flowing garment. The child, shown waist-up, is facing the woman, with soft, curling hair and a hand reaching towards her. The artwork is monochrome with shades of green and white, emphasizing the intricate details of the figures and their clothing. The background features lush floral designs surrounding the figures.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink heightened with white over black chalk, incised with stylus
artworks.description: A man on horseback drives a spear into a dragon in this nearly square drawing. Created with brown washes on darkened, tan paper, the scene emerges slowly, and many details are indistinct. The horse faces away from us angled to our left. Its front legs rear up and its head turned so we see it in profile. The rider braces against the stirrup we can see and plunges a spear into a serpentine dragon to our lower left. Some areas are defined with cream-white or charcoal-gray lines. For instance, white lines shape the rider’s clothing and delineate where the underside of the horse stands out against the background. The horse’s eyes, nose, and parted mouth are drawn in with gray. A tiny star mark is near the lower left corner of the sheet and an incomplete black stamp with initials is in the lower right.

artworks.title: Path through a Wheat Field (Sentier dans les bles)
artworks.description: This image shows an elevated view of a grassy landscape with sparse trees and vegetation at the horizon. The linear brushstrokes create texture and movement in the grass and sky. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. In the foreground, a figure is on a horse amidst tall grasses, while in the distance, another figure stands on the left and a cluster of trees is on the right. The sky has wisps of clouds.

artworks.title: La Vieille aux Loques
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on pale blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated, with her full body visible. She is positioned in a bent-forward posture, engaged in an activity involving her hands. Her facial features are partially obscured, with the side of her face turned slightly downcast. Her hair is covered by a bonnet, and she is clothed in a long dress with a shawl or wrap over her shoulders. The space around her appears dimly lit and cluttered with various items like baskets, bottles, and cooking tools, suggesting it might be a kitchen or storage area. The background is filled with cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Cape Spartell from the West
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of Cape Spartel from the west. The horizon line is low in the composition, where the sea meets the land. A mountainous ridge is visible on the horizon, gently sloping across the scene. The landscape is depicted with fine lines and soft brushstrokes, showcasing the texture and form of the land. Earth tones dominate the color palette, with hints of blues in the sea and sky. The sky is a light neutral shade, maintaining a serene atmosphere and directing attention to the land and sea.

artworks.title: Christ Driving the Money Changers from the Temple
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a crowded scene featuring figures and animals. The image shows a bustling atmosphere with various animated actions. There are animals, likely cattle, among the figures. The setting includes classical columns and a large chandelier, suggesting an architectural interior. The figures are engaged in activity and are grouped in clusters. The detailed lines and crosshatching create texture, adding depth to the figures and surroundings. The style resembles Rembrandt, with an etching technique, dynamic composition, and chiaroscuro for drama and light.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Mars
artworks.artist: Lorenzo Baldissera Tiepolo after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.description: The image contains swirling and flowing lines creating various shapes and forms. Figures, a chariot-like object, more figures, and animal shapes are present. The arrangement suggests chaotic motion, with figures floating or falling through space. Familiar objects like a horse-drawn cart, human forms, and a canine figure contribute to the visual narrative.

artworks.title: Thesis
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in green and black
artworks.description: This image depicts a detailed scene with two seated figures, each holding a stone tablet, flanked by winged cherubs. The figure on the left's tablet is inscribed with "OMNIBUS IDEM," while the figure on the right's tablet is inscribed with "NOXIA INNOXIA QUE." The cherubs are in the center, one pointing towards an illuminated emblem above with the word "LIBERTAS." Below, the cherubs gesture towards a vase among several books, one open and marked with the date "MDCLXXXX." The scene is intricately detailed with rich textures in drapery, clouds, and figures.

artworks.title: O douleur!... avoir rêvé... un époux...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people by a lakeside under some trees. One person is sitting and leaning against a tree, looking upward with a "thoughtful" expression, holding a book. Beside them, another person sits facing the water with a fishing rod in hand, wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The scene is set under a canopy of twisted branches, providing a sense of solitude and reflection. The drawing uses a play of light and shadow, with lines conveying detail and atmosphere. The mood evokes quiet contemplation amidst nature.

artworks.title: Promenade du Boeuf gras
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a parade scene. The artwork depicts a bustling street with buildings in the background. Figures observe from windows. The parade shows various figures in costumes and headwear. One figure is seated on a high chair or float, holding a scythe. The scene is filled with movement and activity, with participants seemingly in action. The drawing features heavy lines and shading.

artworks.title: Une Représentation a bénéfice
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from the waist up. The person on the left is in profile, facing the older man on the right, who is facing forward with a slightly turned head. The younger individual has distinct facial features with a prominent nose and mouth, and long hair tucked under a hat adorned with a large feather. He wears a garment with a pronounced ruffled collar and a decorative chain. The older individual has a long, thick beard and hair, with deep set, expressive eyes and a furrowed brow. His clothing consists of a robe or cloak that covers his shoulders. There are no distinguishable jewelry pieces, but the younger person appears to be gesturing slightly with one hand. The background is shaded darkly behind the two figures.

artworks.title: Three Peasants at an Inn, One Looking Down a Jug
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.5 x 9.1 cm (4 1/8 x 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three men from the thighs up. Two men are sitting, while the third is standing and leaning over a small table. The seated man on the left is holding a jug. The standing man is leaning in towards the others, while the seated man on the right rests a hand on the table. They are wearing simple, modest clothing such as coats or heavy shirts, with hats on their heads. One man wears a wide-brimmed hat, while the other two wear rounded hats. The background displays a textured wall with an arched structure resembling a doorway or alcove, suggesting an interior setting, possibly rustic or modest. The etching is detailed with cross-hatching and shading characteristic of this artistic style.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Woman (Tête de vielle dame)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's face and part of their shoulders. The person is facing forward with a slight tilt to their head, looking directly ahead. Their facial features are detailed, with prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a smile. The person's hair is mostly covered by a cloth headdress. They are wearing a draped garment that covers the shoulders and neck. There are no visible signs of jewelry or objects being held. The background is a strong contrast of dark tones with some light surrounding the silhouette of the head and shoulders.

artworks.title: Veduta della Girandola a Castel Sant'Angelo (Fireworks Display over the Castle Sant'Angelo)
artworks.medium: etching with tengraving and burnishing on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene along a river near the Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome. The point of view is from a lower vantage point, with the river, architecture, and fireworks in view. The artwork features detailed etching techniques creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on light and shadow for form and atmosphere. People are seen in boats and on the riverbanks watching the event, with a stone bridge connecting the scene to the castle in the background.

artworks.title: Grenadier
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. The individual has their left arm across their chest and a clenched right fist by their side. The person's face is detailed, featuring a mustache and wearing a tall fur hat. The attire consists of a fitted jacket with epaulettes, tight trousers tucked into boots, various straps, and a sash. The background includes sketchy lines indicating a ground and foliage. The artist's signature and the year 1817 are visible at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.medium: engraving with pen and ink and wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures engaged in various poses. In the center, a figure is on an elevated platform surrounded by others. One person reaches towards them. The drawing features detailed contrasts, flowing garments, intense expressions, and play of light and shadow. In the background, there are architectural elements and natural scenery. The scene conveys motion and narrative intrigue.

artworks.title: Edge of a Wood with Peasants Going to Market
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a rural landscape with trees obscuring the horizon. In the distance, there is a cart on a winding path with a person walking beside it. Closer to the viewer, there is a person with a child under a tree, accompanied by a small dog. The artwork features fine and detailed brushwork with cross-hatching for texture and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic in muted browns, emphasizing details and creating a peaceful scene under soft light filtered through the trees. The trees form a canopy framing the serene setting.

artworks.title: Hilly Landscape with Travelers on Foot
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. On the left side, there is a large tree with a twisted trunk and dense foliage. A winding path can be seen with a figure walking with a dog. In the distance, a river winds through the land, and there are rolling hills and trees in the background. The color scheme is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Edge of a Wood with Travelers in a Carriage
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a winding path leading into the distance. There are large trees on the right side and travelers on the path, including a figure with a horse-drawn cart and pedestrians. The scene includes hills, valleys, and a sky with light clouds. The color scheme is sepia-toned, with detailed brushstrokes emphasizing depth and texture in the trees and surroundings.

artworks.title: View in Normandy (Vue prise en Normandie)
artworks.description: This image shows a rural landscape with a pond in the foreground where cattle are being herded by a person on horseback. There are low buildings with smoking chimneys in the middle ground. Trees on the horizon separate the land from the sky, which is filled with clouds. The painting is detailed with a consistent brushwork, capturing foliage and buildings. The color palette is primarily sepia, giving a vintage and serene feel to the scene.

artworks.title: Young Woman Wearing a Scarf
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Mr. and Mrs. Ronald S. Lauder
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body, with her head and shoulders in a profile view. She is facing slightly to her left, with her head turned towards the viewer. The woman's facial features are depicted with delicate lines, including her eyes, nose, and lips. Her hair is covered by a headpiece that wraps around her face and hangs down at the back. She wears simple clothing with a visible neckline. The background is plain, without any additional elements.
